title: Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 8: Faunal Diversity · B: Zoology · 34 teaching hours

• Protista: Outline classification; Protozoa diagnostic features/classification up to class; Paramecium caudatum, Plasmodium vivax/falciparum (habits, habitat, structure, reproduction, life-cycle, economic importance).
  • Animalia: Level of organization, body plan, symmetry, coelom, segmentation. Phyla classification up to class: Porifera, Coelenterata, Platyhelminthes, Aschelminthes, Annelida, Arthropoda, Mollusca, Echinodermata, Chordata.
  • Earthworm (Pheretima posthuma): Anatomy and biological systems (digestive, excretory, nervous, reproductive, copulation, cocoon formation).
  • Frog (Rana tigrina): External features and systems (digestive, vascular, respiratory, reproductive).
